newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss banks losing clients, says Adnan Khashoggi.
newsitem.headline: Swiss banks losing clients, says Adnan Khashoggi.

text.p: Saudi Arabian financier Adnan Khashoggi said at a Swiss business forum at the weekend that Switzerland's banks were losing clients because of the unclaimed Jewish assets crisis.
"Swiss banks have lost clients. It's time for them to clean up their act," the Paris-based businessman told Reuters during the annual Crans Montana international business forum.
"They had a good reputation, Swiss banks. They have good facilities and professionalism. But they lost psychologically," said Khashoggi.
Swiss banks are under an international spotlight amid accusations from Jewish groups that they hoarded the assets of Jews killed by Hitler.
Khashoggi said money was still flowing from the Middle East to Swiss private banks, but added: "Swiss banks will lose their secrecy for special people like government officials and presidents."
Khashoggi announced plans at the forum for a new investment bank to fund projects in the Caucasus region.
He said he had no plans to use Swiss banks for his new business.
